import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Check existing tokens from prior runs if available
print('has venmo_token', 'venmo_token' in globals())
print('has simple_note_token', 'simple_note_token' in globals())
print('has phone_token', 'phone_token' in globals())

# Helper to login if token missing
creds = {c['account_name']: c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}

if 'simple_note_token' not in globals() or not simple_note_token:
    simple_note_login = apis.simple_note.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=creds['simple_note'])
    print('simple_note_login', simple_note_login)
    simple_note_token = simple_note_login.get('access_token')

if 'venmo_token' not in globals() or not venmo_token:
    venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=creds['venmo'])
    print('venmo_login', venmo_login)
    venmo_token = venmo_login.get('access_token')

if 'phone_token' not in globals() or not phone_token:
    phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='6017026518', password=creds['phone'])
    print('phone_login', phone_login)
    phone_token = phone_login.get('access_token')

# Identify relevant dinner notes by title substring
all_matches=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query='Friends Dinner', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('simple_note search page', page_index, 'n', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    all_matches.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Keep only notes whose title contains 'Friends Dinner' (case-insensitive)
notes=[n for n in all_matches if 'Friends Dinner' in n.get('title','')]
print('dinner_notes_count', len(notes))
print('dinner_notes', [(n['note_id'], n['title'], n.get('created_at')) for n in notes])

# Fetch note contents for these notes
note_contents={}
for n in notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=n['note_id'], access_token=simple_note_token)
    note_contents[n['note_id']] = note

# Parse shares: lines like '- Name => $23'
share_re = re.compile(r'^-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*\$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$')
shares_by_person={}

note_dates=[]
for nid,note in note_contents.items():
    created = note.get('created_at')
    if created:
        note_dates.append(created.split('T')[0])
    for line in note.get('content','').splitlines():
        m = share_re.match(line.strip())
        if not m:
            continue
        name=m.group(1).strip()
        amt=float(m.group(2))
        shares_by_person[name]=shares_by_person.get(name,0.0)+amt

print('shares_by_person', shares_by_person)

# Fetch received transactions over range spanning dinner note dates
if note_dates:
    min_date=min(note_dates)
    max_date=max(note_dates)
else:
    # fallback to yesterday
    yesterday_date=(datetime.now()-timedelta(days=1)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    min_date=max_date=yesterday_date

print('transaction_date_range', min_date, max_date)

received_txns=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token, direction='received', min_created_at=min_date, max_created_at=max_date, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('received_txns page', page_index, 'n', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    received_txns.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('received_txns_total', len(received_txns))

# Determine which participants already paid
# Match transaction.sender.name first token against participant key
participant_names=list(shares_by_person.keys())
participant_lower={p.lower():p for p in participant_names}

paid_names=set()
paid_emails=set()

for tx in received_txns:
    sender = tx.get('sender', {})
    sender_name = sender.get('name','')
    sender_email = sender.get('email','')
    if not sender_name:
        continue
    first = sender_name.strip().split()[0]
    key = first.lower()
    if key in participant_lower:
        person = participant_lower[key]
        amt = float(tx.get('amount',0.0))
        if abs(amt - shares_by_person[person]) < 1e-6:
            paid_names.add(person)
            if sender_email:
                paid_emails.add(sender_email)

print('paid_names', paid_names)
print('paid_emails', paid_emails)

unpaid_people=[p for p in participant_names if p not in paid_names]
print('unpaid_people', unpaid_people)

# For each unpaid person, find their Venmo user email

def search_venmo_user_emails(name, max_pages=50, page_limit=20):
    emails=[]
    page_index=0
    while page_index<max_pages:
        res = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=name, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('venmo search_users', name, 'page', page_index, 'n', len(res) if res else 0)
        if not res:
            break
        for u in res:
            emails.append(u.get('email'))
        page_index += 1
    # keep unique while preserving order
    seen=set(); uniq=[]
    for e in emails:
        if not e: continue
        if e not in seen:
            seen.add(e); uniq.append(e)
    return uniq

# Fetch phone contact emails for disambiguation

def search_phone_emails(name, max_pages=50, page_limit=20):
    emails=[]
    page_index=0
    while page_index<max_pages:
        res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=name, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('phone search_contacts', name, 'page', page_index, 'n', len(res) if res else 0)
        if not res:
            break
        for c in res:
            emails.append(c.get('email'))
        page_index += 1
    seen=set(); uniq=[]
    for e in emails:
        if not e: continue
        if e not in seen:
            seen.add(e); uniq.append(e)
    return uniq

requests_to_send=[]

for person in unpaid_people:
    venmo_emails = search_venmo_user_emails(person)
    print('person', person, 'venmo_emails', venmo_emails)

    # If exactly one venmo email candidate, use it.
    chosen=None
    if len(venmo_emails)==1:
        chosen=venmo_emails[0]
    else:
        # Use phone contacts as additional filter
        phone_emails=search_phone_emails(person)
        phone_set=set(phone_emails)
        filtered=[e for e in venmo_emails if e in phone_set]
        print('person', person, 'phone_emails', phone_emails, 'filtered', filtered)
        if len(filtered)==1:
            chosen=filtered[0]

    if chosen:
        requests_to_send.append((person, chosen, shares_by_person[person]))

print('requests_to_send', requests_to_send)

# Create payment requests
created=[]
for person,email,amt in requests_to_send:
    resp = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(user_email=email, amount=amt, access_token=venmo_token, description='Friends Dinner')
    print('create_payment_request for', person, 'email', email, 'amt', amt, 'resp', resp)
    created.append(resp)

print('created_count', len(created))
